hints.title: Parity and Movement Mechanism
hints.text: The first time you reach room i, you have visited all previous rooms an even number of times. You are sent back to nextVisit[i].

hints.title: Recurrence for First Visit Differences
hints.text: Let dp[i] be the number of days to advance from room i to room i + 1 for the first time. To go from nextVisit[i] back to i takes sum(dp[nextVisit[i]..i-1]) days.

hints.title: Prefix Sum Acceleration
hints.text: dp[i] = (2 + prefix[i] - prefix[nextVisit[i]]) % modulo. Maintain running prefix sums of dp to compute each step in constant time.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Linear recurrence computing days to unlock each successive room.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Direct day-by-day simulation times out due to exponential path oscillations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Prefix recurrence computes the exact day modulo 10^9 + 7 in linear time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize the even-parity invariant and set up the recurrence relation.
